---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Propose a scoped improvement with clear workflow and safety boundaries
---

## User problem

Who is affected, and what workflow is currently difficult? English and Chinese are welcome.

## Proposed behavior and non-goals

Describe inputs, outputs and what must remain unchanged. Link an existing roadmap item when relevant.

## Authority and state

Does this add code execution, credentials, network destinations, persistent state, remote writes, or new dependencies? What requires human approval, and how does failure preserve work?

## Acceptance evidence

How can the behavior be tested using synthetic/local fixtures? Distinguish desired behavior from already implemented capabilities. Do not include private deployment details.
